description:
A Spotify track by link/URI/ID: title, artists, duration, release date, explicit flag, cover image and 30-second preview URL.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id` OR `track`.
Returns: id (string), link (string), title (string), artists (array<object>), duration_ms (integer, nullable), release_date (string, nullable), is_explicit (boolean), is_playable (boolean), has_video (boolean), preview_url (string, nullable), image_url (string, nullable).

url.description: Track link, URI or ID. Example: "https://open.spotify.com/track/0V3wPSX9ygBnCm8psDIegu"

name: spotify_track
title: Spotify track
